entities.name: YopJ acetyltransferase
observations: The 288-aa query sequence is an exact sequence match to curated Yersinia pseudotuberculosis YopJ proteins P0DUC9, A0A0N9NCU6, and P0DUD0: 100% identity and 100% coverage.
YopJ is a serine/threonine-protein acetyltransferase and bacterial type III secretion effector.
The query contains the Acetyltransf_14 domain PF03421.24 at residues 28–283.
Curated active-site residues in exact-match references include positions 109, 128, and 172; mutation of position 172 abolishes acetyltransferase activity in curated evidence.

entities.name: Protein serine O-acetylation
observations: The enzyme transfers an acetyl group from acetyl-CoA to a protein-bound serine residue, producing O-acetyl-L-seryl-[protein] and CoA.
Reaction candidates are mapped to Rhea:59392, Rhea:59393, and Rhea:9863 in the retrieved curated annotations.

entities.name: Protein threonine O-acetylation
observations: The enzyme transfers an acetyl group from acetyl-CoA to a protein-bound threonine residue, producing O-acetyl-L-threonyl-[protein] and CoA.
Reaction candidates are mapped to Rhea:65340, Rhea:65341, Rhea:11060, and Rhea:16780 in the retrieved curated annotations.

entities.name: 1D-myo-inositol hexakisphosphate
observations: Curated YopJ annotations identify 1D-myo-inositol hexakisphosphate (ChEBI:CHEBI:58130; IP6) as an activating cofactor/allosteric activator of protein-acetyltransferase activity.
IP6 binding promotes a conformational rearrangement that stimulates interaction with acetyl-CoA.

entities.name: YopJ acetyltransferase
observations: Curated target proteins include host MAP2K1, MAP2K6, MAP3K7/TAK1, CHUK/IKKA, IKBKB, and RIPK2/RICK; acetylation of activation-loop serine/threonine residues blocks phosphorylation-dependent kinase activation.
The enzyme is secreted through the bacterial type III secretion system.
